what_it_changes: When enabled in local inference mode, aiSettingsService.rankLocalPickerModelsByBackendCatalog passes promoteAllWithoutOverlap=true to xGy/ygf so all Ollama picker models are promoted to section 1 (defaultOn) when backend catalog name overlap is empty; when disabled (bundled default false), zero-overlap yields no promotions and local models stay in section 99 (hidden from default selection). Wired in both desktop and glass via checkFeatureGate(j0u/XYh).
modules: experimentConfig.gen.js (B5e/xNe), localProviderModelEnrichment.js, localProviderModelMatch.js (xGy/ygf, KYh/VYh), experimentService.js, aiSettingsService.js (refreshDefaultModels, fetchLocalProviderModelEnrichment, rankLocalPickerModelsByBackendCatalog)
local_override: experimentService.setFeatureFlagOverride (dev builds, persisted TTL); remote Statsig gate (disableExposureLog false)
